needs_review.finding: LSU / Christ the King Catholic Student Center lists its team as Jake, Kelley, Fisher, Lucina, Elloway and John, plus spouses Josh and Taryn and a child Charlie.
needs_review.recommendation: Not emitted. Only Kelley was recoverable, and only because focus.org independently publishes Kelley Hartman at LSU - she is emitted on her own page, not by pairing. Do not pair the other first names with surnames from anywhere. The named spouses Josh and Taryn are first-name-only and the child Charlie is excluded by the children rule.

needs_review.finding: Erin Falbo is described as a FORMER FOCUS campus missionary at UT Austin.
needs_review.recommendation: Not emitted. Tier A requires a currently support-raising missionary; 'former' fails that. Flagging in case the CRM wants alumni separately.

needs_review.issue: First-name-only teammate and a child on a cited page
needs_review.finding: The team listing on Anne Clare Culpepper's focus.org page reads 'Jacob, Mallory, baby John, Ignacio, Ellie, Nick, Annaliese, Haley May'.
needs_review.recommendation: 'Mallory' emitted nowhere - first name only, probably Jacob Palchak's wife, but that is an inference and the rules forbid pairing. 'baby John' excluded under the children-are-not-missionaries rule.

needs_review.issue: Out-of-slice roster surfaced by my first query - hand to focus-newman-mw
needs_review.finding: newmanec.com (Newman Parish/Newman Catholic, Eau Claire, Wisconsin - not Texas, despite what the query looked like it returned) publishes a full-name 2025-2026 roster: Micah Gehring, Jaden Henley (Team Director), Marie Henley (described as a FOCUS wife and honorary team member), Rose VonErden and Kaylie (Katherine) Skoumal.
needs_review.recommendation: I did not emit these - Wisconsin belongs to the focus-newman-mw slice. Hand the page to that agent; it is a clean full-name roster with a stated current year. Note Marie Henley is called an 'honorary team member' rather than a commissioned missionary, so her tier needs a judgement call.

needs_review.issue: Diocesan pages that confirm FOCUS presence but name nobody
needs_review.finding: Diocese of Jackson (MS), Archdiocese of Oklahoma City, Diocese of Charlotte, Diocese of Owensboro (Murray State and Western Kentucky) and Diocese of Orlando all publish campus-ministry pages confirming FOCUS teams without naming a single missionary in any indexed snippet.
needs_review.recommendation: The diocesan-announcement pattern the brief hoped for is weak in this region compared with the campus-ministry sites themselves. Prioritise campus sites over diocesan sites on any follow-up here.
